text: This isn't supposed to be a rude question, but do you think before you speak, because you answer questions so quickly and so comprehensively, whether it's about geopolitics or your sport or aerodynamics, like, can you take us into your brain? a pensive person. Like, I'm a very introspective. I'm an introspective young woman. Like, I

I'm always like trying to modify. I'm trying to
think how can I be better? How can I approach my own brain the way that I approach my craft
